title: fix(spec): the report panel's English rows read in business terms
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB9Gqqp1VYZwEqbXEm1YsTjU)_
Fixes #36447
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziH9MVhWYLVCiw5eXB

## 维护者速读

- 报表设计器右侧属性面板在英文界面下，所有说明文字和栏目名改成业务用语（数据来源、分组、指标、排序），时间段与导出下面的六个子项也各有自己的名称和说明，与中文面板说法一致；日文、西班牙文同步补上了新增的六项。
- 属于"报表与仪表盘面板说业务话"这项体验工作的英文收尾，替用英文界面搭报表的业务管理员解决看不懂开发术语的问题。
- 只改了说明文字和表单排布，不改任何可保存的设置；出错最多是某句提示读起来别扭，直接撤回即可。
- 无

## What changes

The report authoring form (`packages/spec/src/ui/report.form.ts`) produces the English rows the console's report panel draws below its curated controls. Per the seat route (producer-first, no `en` overlay, no rename of a section title whose key is slugged from its label), every such row now reads in business terms carrying the zh-CN meaning: data source, grouping, metric, sort.

- **Round 1**: reworded the section descriptions and hints that no pin held.
- **Round 2**, on the seat's widened surface (claim amendment 7119493070):
  - Rewords the six ledger-pinned hints and moves the two platform-objects echo-decision ledgers' `en` sources with them. ⚠️ Each moved row records that its zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES verdicts and values were taken against the OLD English and were not re-judged.
  - Declares the `dateRange` and `exportOptions` children and a Description hint as form rows, with a completeness pin (`report-form-composite-children.test.ts`, the #30267 view-form shape).
  - Renames the joined-block and sort row titles in the form and in the item schema `.meta({ title })` together, which the repeater-item-titles pin requires.
- **Translations**: the 13 new catalog leaves are regenerated in every platform `*.metadata-forms.generated.ts`, with zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES values authored. The other locales carry the English fill and its provenance entry.
  - The console's zh overlay (`metadata-form-zh-cn.ts`) carries the six new children: that file's rule is that every `report` field string the curated inspector renders lives there, copied from the platform zh-CN bundle.
- **Measured premise correction**: the dashboard **widget** panel (`DashboardWidgetInspector.tsx`) draws **zero** rows from spec text. Its rows are console strings (`engine.inspector.widget.*`) that already read "Data source", "Group by", "Metrics" in English.

**Row table — every English row the report panel draws from spec text** (lines on base 4c93f880; enumerated by rendering `ReportDefaultInspector` in English for summary, matrix and joined reports with every section open, then re-rendered at the final head)

| Row | Source | Before | After |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| Section "Basics", description | report.form.ts:24 | Identity and report type. | unchanged (same meaning as zh-CN 标识与报表类型) |
| Description, hint | i18n.zod.ts:275 (shared `I18nLabel` describe; no form hint) | Display label — the default-language string, or an inline locale map ({ en, "zh-CN" }) resolved at render time | One sentence on what this report shows, displayed under its name. (form row hint; the shared describe is untouched) |
| Section "Dataset binding", label | report.form.ts:34 | Dataset binding | **left over** (slugged section key) |
| Section "Dataset binding", description | report.form.ts:35 | The semantic-layer dataset this report renders. Values are the dataset’s measures; rows are its dimensions. | Where the report’s numbers come from, how they are grouped and sorted, and which records open when you click a row. |
| Order, label | prettified | Order | Sort Order |
| Order, hint | report.form.ts:51 | Sort keys, most significant first (a rows/columns dimension or a values measure). Time dimensions are chronological by default. | What to sort by, most important first (a grouping or a metric). Time groupings sort in date order by default. |
| Order rows, label | report.form.ts:57 = report.zod.ts:107 title | Order By | Sort By |
| Drilldown, hint | report.form.ts:61 | Click an aggregated row/cell to open the underlying records | Click a summarized row or cell to open the records behind it. |
| Section "Joined blocks", label | report.form.ts:65 | Joined blocks | **left over** (slugged section key) |
| Section "Joined blocks", description | report.form.ts:66 | Additional dataset-bound blocks stacked into a single report (joined reports only). | Other blocks stacked into the same report, each with its own data source (joined reports only). |
| Blocks, hint | report.form.ts:72 | Dataset-bound sub-reports (joined report only) | Sub-reports, each with its own data source (joined reports only). |
| Blocks rows | report.form.ts:89-94 = `JoinedReportBlockSchema` titles | Dataset / Rows / Columns / Values / Order | Data Source / Group By / Group Columns By / Metrics / Sort Order |
| Section "Filter & chart", description | report.form.ts:101 | Render-time scope filter and chart presentation. | Filter conditions and how the chart is shown. |
| Runtime Filter, hint | report.form.ts:105 | Render-time scope filter, ANDed at query time | A filter applied whenever the report is shown, on top of the data source’s own conditions. |
| Date Range, hint | report.form.ts:122 | Default period and custom-range switch. The dimension must be a date dimension of the dataset; leave it empty when the dataset has exactly one. | The period the report opens with, and whether people may choose their own range. |
| Date Range children | report.zod.ts:702-705 describes (no form rows) | Dimension: Dataset dimension (declared `type: 'date'`) the window applies to; omitted = the dataset's one date dimension · Default Range: Default date range preset · Allow Custom Range: Allow users to pick a custom date range | Date Field: The date grouping of the data source the period applies to. Leave it empty when the data source has only one. · Default Period: The period the report opens with. · Allow Custom Range: Let people pick their own start and end dates. |
| Export Options, hint | report.form.ts:123 | Download formats (csv, xlsx) and file name. Who may download is the export permission on the dataset object. | Download formats (csv, xlsx) and file name. Who may download is set by the export permission on the data source’s object. |
| Export Options children | list-view-export-options.ts:195-198 describes (no form rows) | Formats: Formats the report's export control offers (default: ['csv', 'xlsx']); an empty list turns the control off · Include Headers: Include column headers in the exported file (default true) · File Name Prefix: Download file name prefix — replaces the report label in the generated file name | Formats: The download formats offered. Left unset, both csv and xlsx are offered; an empty list turns downloads off. · Include Headers: Put the column names in the first row of the downloaded file. · File Name: The start of the downloaded file’s name, used instead of the report name. |

Rows the panel does not draw, because its curated controls replace them (the server-served form still renders them):

| Row | Source | Before | After |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| Type, hint | report.form.ts:30 | Report type: tabular/summary/matrix/joined | Report type: tabular, summary, matrix or joined. |
| Dataset, hint | report.form.ts:39 | Dataset to bind (measures/dimensions come from its semantic layer) | The report reads its numbers from here; everyone sees only the records they have access to. |
| Values, hint | report.form.ts:40 | Measure names (from the dataset) to display | The metrics to total or count (from the data source). |
| Rows, hint | report.form.ts:41 | Dimension names (from the dataset) to group rows by | The fields to group by (from the data source). |
| Columns, hint | report.form.ts:43 | Dimension names across (matrix only) | Groups spread across the columns (matrix reports only). |
| Chart, hint | report.form.ts:108 | Chart config (type, legend, colors) | Chart type and settings. |

**Left over — section titles whose key is slugged from the label** (not renamed, per the seat route: renaming moves the `dataset_binding` / `joined_blocks` keys of the zh overlay and of every `metadataForms` catalog):

- "Dataset binding" (report.form.ts:34)
- "Joined blocks" (report.form.ts:65)

Unchanged on purpose: the "Runtime Filter" and "Drilldown" labels (zh-CN reads the same words; the ledger records both as correct English). The top-level Dataset / Values / Rows / Columns labels are not drawn by the panel. The shared `I18nLabel` and list-view export describes are untouched, per the seat route.

## Tests

<details><summary>Spec, platform translations, console tests — green at 60b7741a; the last commit f2cbae0a touches two test files only, re-run green</summary>

- spec: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/` plus repeater-item-titles, metadata-form-declared-rows.pin, i18n-resolver and schema-index: Test Files 192 passed (192), Tests 7209 passed (7209). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` exit 0.
- New pin `src/ui/report-form-composite-children.test.ts`: 6 tests. Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, deleting the `includeHeaders` row: "Tests 1 failed / 5 passed", restored blob == HEAD.
- platform-objects: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: Test Files 125 passed (125), Tests 2126 passed (2126). This includes both report echo-decision ledgers and the object-lifecycle positive control (763, then 765 after the merge of main, then 771).
- ui, from `ui/`, over every report-form reader (all `ReportDefaultInspector*`, `panelBusinessWording-36373`, `report-schema`, `metadata-form-i18n`, `InterfacesPillar.report*`, `metadataError.report*`, `ReportConfigPanel*`, `ReportView*` and more, 35 files): first run 17 failed in 5 files, all pinning the old labels. After those pins moved: 5 passed (5), 37 tests; the other 30 files passed.
- At merged head 60b7741a: platform-objects 125/125 files, 2126/2126 tests; spec 192/192, 7209/7209; ui 35/35, 273/273. Every run exited 0 under the verify lock.
- f2cbae0a: `check:test-source-alias` red on CI (lane `lint-ci-engine`, rolled up as Lint & Repo Gates). Cause: the two edited pins reach the console's dynamic `@objectstack/lint` / `@objectstack/formula` imports inside a case's clock. Fix: module-top side-effect imports. Local result: `check-test-source-alias OK`, EXIT=0, and the two files pass 2/2 files, 6/6 tests.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The ja-JP and es-ES values of the six reworded ledger rows still render the old developer meaning (the zh-CN values already matched the business meaning). Re-judging them belongs to a translator pass, not this card.
- The Default Period select shows the stored preset (`this_month`) as its option text, in both locales: the enum has no option labels in this form. Out of scope here.
- Open draft PR #36802 regenerates the same bundles; the generated files are `merge=os-regen`, so whichever lands second regenerates.

## Verification

First read, by risk: `packages/spec/src/ui/report.form.ts` (the declared children and every reworded row); `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/report-form-echo-decisions.test.ts` (moved `en` sources, counts and their reason); `packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts` (six `.meta({ title })` strings, prose only).

Two-minute check: open a summary report in the Studio with the console in English and expand "Period & export". It should show Date Field, Default Period and Allow Custom Range, then Formats, Include Headers and File Name, each with a plain-language hint. Switch to Chinese and the same rows read 日期字段 / 默认时间段 / 允许自定义范围 / 格式 / 包含表头 / 文件名.
